notes: Volvo's Connected Vehicle and Energy APIs use Volvo ID OAuth plus a VCC API key per application; owner consent is required and full credentials for a shared app are granted manually (reported 14-21 days, developer portal blocked automated fetch). Volvo-ID logins expire weekly per evcc docs.

name: Xiaomi Home
alternative: Xiaomi devices exposed through Home Assistant's official Xiaomi Home integration, or Apple Home for HomeKit-capable devices
notes: No self-serve public cloud API; Xiaomi's own Home Assistant integration (github.com/XiaoMi/ha_xiaomi_home) signs in with Xiaomi's OAuth client to MIoT Cloud, with local control through a central hub gateway. MCP servers (e.g. github.com/oujiafan/mcp-mijia) are community and use unofficial APIs.

name: BandLab
alternative: Mixdowns and individual tracks the person downloads from their BandLab Library or Studio to the Mac, in the format they choose
notes: No public API or MCP found for BandLab accounts and no registry entry. Downloads cover finished mixdowns and tracks of the person's own projects, not segments, project structure, comments or social activity.

name: Mullvad VPN
alternative: Official mullvad CLI on the Mac (status, connect, relay and account commands)
notes: No documented public account API or MCP; Mullvad ships an official mullvad CLI with the desktop app that a local plugin can run. Mullvad is a paid subscription; no registry entry found.

name: IXL
alternative: PDF of an IXL Analytics report (Student Summary, Score Chart, Usage and others) that the parent generates and saves from the website, plus IXL's weekly summary emails to a parent in the person's mailbox (IMAP)
notes: No public consumer API or MCP; IXL's integrations are school rostering partnerships, not for a family account. IXL documents a print button on Analytics reports that generates a PDF the parent can save, and weekly summary emails with achievements for parents who turn them on. Each PDF is a one-off snapshot and question-level data stays on the website; CSV score export is documented for teacher accounts only.

name: XING
alternative: the person's self-service XING data archive (Settings > Privacy > Data protection > personal data report), downloaded as a ZIP of HTML documents
notes: The old XING REST API no longer accepts new applications; dev.xing.com now offers only Share and Login-with-XING plugins and partner job integrations, and no registry entry was found. The archive is a one-off snapshot in HTML (not CSV or JSON) that takes some time to prepare.

name: Sky
alternative: Bill and account emails in the person's mailbox (IMAP)
notes: No public customer API or MCP for Sky TV, broadband or mobile accounts. Home Assistant's Sky Q box control uses an undocumented local protocol and is not a supported route.

name: Wealthsimple
alternative: Activities export (CSV) and statements from Documents in the Wealthsimple web app
notes: No public account API; community MCP servers (e.g. wealthsimple-mcp-server on mcp.so) cover only public help and promo content. The help centre documents a CSV activities export, but it blocked automated fetches.

name: PDF Expert
alternative: Read and write the person's PDF files on the Mac directly; open files in PDF Expert through its URL scheme
notes: Readdle documents keyboard shortcuts and URL schemes for opening files but no API, AppleScript dictionary or MCP. Documents are ordinary local files, so Kipster can work on them without the app.

name: The Criterion Channel
alternative: none that qualifies; subscription billing emails carry no viewing data and the watchlist stays in the app
notes: Subscription streaming service with no public API or MCP; the help centre documents no watchlist or history export and the App Store listing mentions no Shortcuts or Siri actions. Criterion's privacy policy, which covers criterionchannel.com and the app, offers access requests by form or privacy@criterion.com in certain US states and Canada but never says a copy or file of the data is provided. Billing and new-programming emails carry no personal viewing data.

name: Huckleberry
alternative: In-app 'Export tracking data as CSV' per child profile, which emails a 24-hour download link to the account address; Huckleberry Shortcuts/Siri actions for logging
notes: No public API or MCP; logs sync only between caregivers inside the app. The help centre documents a CSV export of all logged data for a child (sleep, feeding, diaper and more), delivered as an emailed download link, and Shortcuts app actions mainly for logging entries. The CSV is a one-off snapshot per child, so Kip reads it after the person exports it; there is no import back into the app.

name: Zoopla
alternative: a UK GDPR access or data portability request emailed to the data protection address in Zoopla's privacy notice, which provides a copy of the person's data (portability in a structured, machine-readable format)
notes: No public consumer API or MCP; developer.zoopla.co.uk did not respond and the site documents no current developer programme. The request gives a one-off snapshot of the account data, limited to UK GDPR rights; property alert emails only describe listings, not the person's own data.

name: ABCmouse
alternative: Data portability request to Age of Learning through its privacy portal (hosted on my.datasubject.com, a third party) or privacy@aofl.com, delivered electronically in a readily usable format; residents of California, Colorado, Connecticut, Utah, Virginia and other listed states only, twice a year
notes: Paid children's learning subscription with no public API, self-service export or MCP; progress reports are viewed in the Parent Center only. The ABCmouse privacy policy offers residents of certain US states a data portability request covering the past 12 months, answered electronically in a readily usable format, which can include a child's learning activity and progress data. It is a one-off snapshot, and progress report emails are documented only for school accounts.

name: Luma
alternative: none
notes: Official MCP at https://mcp.luma.com for any Luma account (no Luma Plus needed): event search, the person's events, and hosting tools. Discovery 2026-10-08: authorization server api.luma.com, DCR no, CIMD yes, S256; token auth none, client secret or private_key_jwt.

name: BBC Sport
alternative: BBC Sport RSS feeds (e.g. feeds.bbci.co.uk/sport/rss.xml)
notes: No public API or MCP for BBC accounts or personalised sport; the BBC publishes free public RSS feeds for headlines and sport sections.

name: Rocket Mortgage
alternative: Mortgage statements (PDF) the person downloads and statement emails in their mailbox
notes: No public consumer API or MCP for loan servicing; access is through the website and app. The website blocked automated fetches.

name: Uniqlo
alternative: Order confirmation and shipping emails in the person's mailbox (IMAP)
notes: No public shopping or account API or MCP; the website blocked automated fetches, so this rests on the App Store listing.

name: Gemini Exchange
alternative: none
notes: Gemini's own open-source local MCP server (gemini/developer-platform) uses an API key and secret the person creates at exchange.gemini.com/settings/api; market data needs no key, and trading, funds and staking tools act on the account, so keys should be scoped read-only where possible. The REST API also documents OAuth; no vendor entry found in the MCP Registry search.

name: Fi
alternative: Privacy access request emailed to support@fitracking.com for a copy of the person's data (machine-readable under GDPR/UK GDPR, commonly used format in Canada, a copy in listed US states); community Home Assistant tools use an unofficial API and are excluded
notes: Fi smart dog collar (tryfi.com now redirects to fitracking.com) has no public API or MCP, and its help centre documents no Apple Health, Shortcuts or self-service export. Fi's privacy policy lets residents of listed US states, Canada, the EU and the UK request a copy of their personal information by email, including pet activity and location data the collar collects. It is a one-off snapshot and not available in other regions.

name: Lidl
alternative: Request through Lidl US's Privacy Choices form for a copy of the person's personal information in a portable format (residents of Delaware, Maryland, New Jersey and Virginia only); Lidl Plus digital receipts stay in the app
notes: No public API or MCP for Lidl Plus accounts, receipts or coupons; community tools reverse-engineer the Lidl Plus app. Lidl US's privacy policy lets residents of four US states request a copy of their personal information in a portable format, which can include loyalty and purchase data, as a one-off snapshot. Lidl Plus e-receipts are stored in the app rather than emailed, and the European Lidl Plus notices cite GDPR portability without describing how a copy is delivered.

name: FreeStyle Libre
alternative: Glucose CSV the person downloads from LibreView (Glucose History, Download Glucose Data)
notes: Abbott offers no public consumer API; Libre apps upload to LibreView and share with LibreLinkUp followers. The registry entry io.github.mcp-dir/librelink-mcp is community, uses the unofficial LibreLinkUp API and routes through a third-party host (api.mcp.ai).

name: Gap
alternative: order and shipping emails in the person's mailbox
notes: No public or consumer API for Gap accounts or orders; no official or community MCP in the registry.

name: ESPNcricinfo
alternative: public RSS feeds for news and live scores
notes: No public API or account data access; ESPNcricinfo publishes public RSS feeds for news, players, teams and live scores, which give scores but nothing from the person's account.

name: Preply
alternative: a Right to Know request emailed to legal@preply.com for a copy of the person's personal data (California residents); lesson reminder emails Preply sends for its services, in the person's mailbox
notes: No public API for learner accounts or lessons found; no MCP in the registry. The privacy policy states a copy only under the California right to know (GDPR rights are listed without a stated copy), and it names service reminders but does not describe their content; payment receipts are learning-service billing and do not count.

name: ASOS
alternative: order and shipping emails in the person's mailbox
notes: No public consumer API for ASOS accounts or orders; no MCP in the registry. The shop site blocked automated fetches, so only the corporate site was opened.

name: Owlet
alternative: Privacy request by email to privacy@owletcare.com (or Owlet's privacy request form where offered) for a copy of the person's data in a portable, readily usable format; residents of US states with privacy laws, the EU/UK, Canada and other listed regions; Cam clips can be saved to the phone within the clip window
notes: No public API for Owlet sock or camera data, no MCP, and no Apple Health or Shortcuts support documented; the help centre says Owlet does not offer a way to download or export data. Owlet's privacy policy lets residents of many US states and other regions request a copy of their personal information in a portable format (machine-readable in the EU/UK), which can include sock readings. It is a one-off snapshot, and unofficial community libraries remain excluded.

name: Daylio
alternative: the person's Daylio backup file or PDF export
notes: No API; Daylio says only the app can read entries, which back up to the person's iCloud or Google Drive, and offers a manual backup file and PDF export.

name: PrizePicks
alternative: deposit, entry and withdrawal emails in the person's mailbox
notes: No public API or data export mentioned in the PrizePicks help centre; no MCP in the registry.

name: PayByPhone
alternative: parking receipt emails in the person's mailbox
notes: No public consumer API; PayByPhone offers business and fleet accounts through a separate business portal, not a personal-account API. No MCP in the registry.

name: Riot Games
alternative: none
notes: Riot's developer portal issues personal API keys after registration without approval (production keys need Developer Relations review); game and match data is read by Riot ID, and Riot Sign On access was not confirmed. The registry lists only github.com/pipeworx-io/mcp-riot-games, a third-party gateway that routes data through its host; excluded.

name: NatWest
alternative: statement export (CSV/OFX) from online banking
notes: Account data is reachable only through UK Open Banking, which requires FCA authorisation as an account information provider; no consumer API or MCP. Aggregators exist but route data through a third party; excluded.

name: FOX One
alternative: Access and portability request through Fox's privacy portal (privacy.fox.com/main/web/consumer) or 888-596-3929 for the person's personal data in a portable form; residents of Colorado, Connecticut, Virginia and other listed US states with privacy laws, plus California's right to know
notes: No public API for FOX One accounts or watch history and no MCP; foxone.com redirects to fox.com, and the app documents no export or Shortcuts actions. The Fox privacy policy shown on the FOX One site lets residents of listed US states request the personal data Fox holds about them, including in a portable form, which can include viewing activity. It is a one-off snapshot limited to those states; subscription billing emails do not count.

name: Upside
alternative: cash-back and receipt emails in the person's mailbox
notes: No consumer API; Upside's partnerships (co-marketing, tech integration, affiliate) are for businesses. No MCP in the registry.

name: BBC Sounds
alternative: a copy of the person's BBC account information and activity requested from BBC account settings (Privacy > Your data), downloadable under the right of access and data portability; BBC Sounds suggested Shortcuts that play a chosen station
notes: No public API for BBC Sounds listening history or subscriptions and no BBC MCP in the registry. The BBC account data request is a one-off copy of most account information and activity, not a live feed; the documented Shortcuts only start playback of a station.

name: Santander
alternative: statement export (CSV/OFX) from online banking
notes: Personal account data is reachable only through regulated open banking (PSD2/UK Open Banking), which needs authorisation as an account information provider; no consumer API or official MCP. Registry lists community servers github.com/codespar/mcp-dev-latam and github.com/mcp-dir/santander-mcp.

name: Viator
alternative: booking confirmation emails in the person's mailbox for existing bookings
notes: Official Viator connector (Made by Viator, sign-in not required) with search_experiences and get_experience_details; catalog search only, no access to the person's bookings. Discovery 2026-10-08: well-known paths blocked by bot protection (403), GET /mcp returned 405; no OAuth metadata found.

name: REI
alternative: order and shipping emails in the person's mailbox
notes: No public consumer API for REI accounts or orders and no MCP in the registry. REI's shipping help says order updates are sent by email, including a shipping confirmation email when a package leaves its facilities.

name: SignUpGenius
alternative: sign-up confirmation emails in the person's mailbox
notes: SignUpGenius's REST API takes a private key the member enables under Tools and returns their own sign-ups, reports and participants as JSON; it is included on every paid Premium plan (Silver 500 requests a day, higher tiers more), so the ordinary paid subscription covers it. Community server github.com/chrischall/signupgenius-mcp in the registry.

name: PurpleAir
alternative: none
notes: Self-serve API keys from PurpleAir Develop; calls use points, new accounts get one million free points and more are bought, and PurpleAir aims to cover sensor owners reading their own sensors. No MCP in the registry.

name: Ko-fi
alternative: payment notification emails in the person's mailbox, or Ko-fi webhooks to an endpoint the person controls
notes: Ko-fi offers only outgoing payment webhooks (donations, subscriptions, shop orders, commissions) to a URL the creator sets, not a readable account API. No MCP in the registry.

name: Klook
alternative: booking confirmation emails in the person's mailbox
notes: No consumer API for Klook accounts or bookings; no official MCP. Community scraper servers on Apify use Klook's mobile API without permission; excluded.

name: Desmos
alternative: Per-graph PNG or SVG image downloads and saved-graph links from the calculator's Share menu; in the EEA and similar regions, a request to privacy@desmos.com for a copy of the person's personal information
notes: The Desmos API embeds calculators in other sites with an API key and gives no access to a person's saved graphs or account; no MCP in the registry. The help centre documents saving graphs to the account and sharing each one as a link or a PNG/SVG image, and the privacy policy lets people in the EEA and similar regions request a copy of their data by email. Images do not carry the editable expressions, 3D graphs and notebooks share only as links, and there is no bulk export of saved work.

name: Axios
alternative: public Axios RSS feed and newsletters in the person's mailbox
notes: No account API; Axios serves a public RSS feed of its stories. No Axios MCP in the registry (axiosdevs servers are unrelated).

name: Freelancer
alternative: project and message notification emails in the person's mailbox
notes: Freelancer has a public OAuth 2.0 API with apps created at accounts.freelancer.com; third-party guides say apps need approval, not confirmed because the developer docs need JavaScript. Registry lists community server github.com/godesigntech/freelancer-mcp-server.

name: Gaia GPS
alternative: GPX, KML or GeoJSON export of the person's tracks, routes, areas, waypoints and folders from gaiagps.com or the app
notes: No public API for Gaia GPS accounts; no MCP in the registry. Export is per item or per folder and gives a snapshot, not a live sync.

name: Aetna
alternative: claims and explanation-of-benefits documents downloaded from the member website
notes: US payers must offer a FHIR Patient Access API under the CMS interoperability rule, which needs third-party app registration with Aetna (CVS Health); registration terms not confirmed. No MCP in the registry.

name: Dailymotion
alternative: none
notes: Public API with OAuth2 scopes for the user's own videos and playlists; an owner or admin creates a public API key in Dailymotion Studio with no review mentioned. Community server github.com/mrfentmen/dailymotion-mcp in the registry.

name: Avast
alternative: Privacy Request form linked from Avast's privacy policy (hosted by OneTrust, a third party) for a machine-readable, portable copy of the person's personal data, where privacy laws such as GDPR or US state laws grant it; Avast Business Hub is for business accounts only
notes: No public API for consumer Avast accounts or products, and no MCP in the registry; business management tools are separate. Avast's privacy policy links a Privacy Request form, and parent company Gen Digital's privacy notice says people may obtain a machine-readable and portable copy of their personal data where privacy laws provide it, which covers account, subscription and product data Avast holds. It is a one-off snapshot, available only where such laws apply.

name: GameChanger
alternative: team schedule calendar subscription (ICS) in the person's calendar
notes: No public API; GameChanger syncs team schedules to Apple or Google calendars through a subscription URL, which Kipster can read as an ICS feed.

name: Cigna
alternative: claims and explanation-of-benefits documents downloaded from the member website
notes: Cigna runs a developer portal for its CMS-mandated FHIR Patient Access API; app registration terms not confirmed because the portal needs JavaScript. No MCP in the registry.

name: Fever
alternative: ticket confirmation emails in the person's mailbox
notes: No public consumer API or MCP found; Fever tickets live only in its app and confirmation emails.

name: Canary Mail
alternative: none for Canary itself; the person's mail stays at their mail provider (Gmail, Outlook, iCloud or another IMAP host), which Kipster reaches through that provider's own connection, not through Canary
notes: Canary is a mail client with no public API, MCP, Shortcuts actions or data export; its privacy policy says it does not store message content and lists GDPR rights without a request flow that delivers a copy. Connecting to the underlying provider uses a different service, so it is not a route for Canary's own data (settings, on-device models).

name: Rumble
alternative: A privacy request emailed to legal@rumble.com (subject "Privacy") for a copy of the person's personal information in a portable, readily usable format; offered to California and other listed US-state residents and, where GDPR-style laws apply, in a structured machine-readable format.
notes: No documented public API or MCP, and Rumble's terms forbid automated access without written permission. Rumble's privacy policy documents a portability right to a copy of provided personal information and an email contact for requests, so a one-off snapshot is possible where those laws apply; it gives no live access to channel analytics or videos.

name: Book of the Month
alternative: order and shipping emails in the person's mailbox
notes: No public API or MCP known. Book of the Month's help centre points members to the tracking link in the shipping confirmation email they receive when they place an order; the emails cover orders and shipping, not reading history.

name: Buy Me a Coffee
alternative: webhooks from Buy Me a Coffee Studio
notes: Creators generate a read-only personal access token in the developer dashboard (supporters, members, extras); the API docs page says it is no longer maintained and points to webhooks, but no vendor page says new tokens are disabled and the dashboard login still routes to studio.buymeacoffee.com. Community MCP github.com/mayeu20/buymeacoffee-mcp; aggregators such as Zapier and Pipedream exist but route data through a third party; excluded.

name: TodayTix
alternative: ticket confirmation emails in the person's mailbox
notes: No public consumer API or MCP found; bookings are reachable only through the app and order emails.

name: MakeMyTrip
alternative: booking confirmation emails and e-tickets in the person's mailbox
notes: No public consumer API or MCP found in the registry; the vendor site did not respond to fetches, so this is unconfirmed.

name: SportsEngine
alternative: team schedule calendar (ICS) subscription
notes: SportsEngine runs a developer portal (dev.sportsengine.com) aimed at organizations and partners; access terms were not readable (script-only page), so partner approval is assumed and unconfirmed.

name: Hinge Health
alternative: A HIPAA medical-records request to Hinge Health's Privacy Officer (privacy@hingehealth.com) for an electronic copy of the person's medical record and other health information; US members under HIPAA.
notes: Employer- and plan-sponsored virtual physical therapy app with no public API or MCP for members, and no Apple Health or Shortcuts support found on its App Store page. Hinge Health's HIPAA notice documents that members can get an electronic or paper copy of their medical record, usually within 30 days and possibly for a cost-based fee. This is a one-off snapshot of clinical records, not live exercise or progress data.

name: iNaturalist
alternative: public observation search needs no auth
notes: Free OAuth2 app registration (authorization code with PKCE) with no review; the Node API takes a 24-hour JWT from /users/api_token. Community MCPs github.com/cyanheads/inaturalist-mcp-server and pipeworx-io/mcp-inaturalist.

name: Incogni
alternative: A privacy request to support@incogni.com for access to, or a copy of, the person's personal data (stated for GDPR and UK GDPR; California residents have a right to know); the regular privacy reports Incogni sends may also carry removal progress.
notes: Data-broker removal service with no public API or MCP; removal status lives in its dashboard. Incogni's privacy policy states users can access their personal data or receive a copy of it by contacting support@incogni.com, which gives a one-off snapshot rather than live removal status. The homepage promises regular privacy reports, but the page does not say what they contain or that they arrive by email.

name: Trivago
alternative: none
notes: Official trivago MCP (registry com.trivago.mcp/mcp) for hotel search and price comparison, free with no API key; it covers public hotel data, not account data. Discovery 2026-10-08: no MCP or OAuth metadata found (404).

name: Spark Driver
alternative: a request for access to a copy of the person's personal information through "Your Privacy Choices" in the Spark Driver app or website footer (or 1-800-925-6278); California residents only
notes: Walmart gig-driver app with no public API or MCP. The privacy request is a one-off copy for California residents; earnings are paid out through third-party providers with their own terms, so exporting from those is a different service and not a route here.

name: Codecademy
alternative: "Download Your Data" request in Codecademy's Privacy Center (privacy.codecademy.com), which emails a report of the data related to the person's account; certificates of completion can be saved as PDFs from the person's profile.
notes: No public API or MCP for learner accounts. Codecademy's Privacy Center offers a Download Your Data request that emails an account data report, a one-off snapshot rather than live course progress. Certificates are per-item downloads that cover only finished courses or paths.

name: CARFAX
alternative: vehicle history reports the person buys and the service history shown in CARFAX Car Care, saved by the person (no vendor page opened confirms a download)
notes: No consumer API or MCP; CARFAX data is sold to dealers and partners, not exposed for a person's own account. CARFAX's pages describe purchased vehicle history reports and the Car Care service history, but no page opened documents a download or export, and its state privacy request form does not say a copy is provided.

name: YouVersion Bible
alternative: none
notes: YouVersion Platform gives a free app key plus Sign in with YouVersion (PKCE OAuth, app key as client_id); the only user data permission is highlights (notes, bookmarks and plans are not supported). App creation asks for use-case details; no review step is documented.

name: NYT Games
alternative: An "Access and Port it" request on The New York Times Data Subject Request Form (nytimes.com/data-subject-request, choosing The New York Times, which covers Games) to obtain a copy of the person's personal information, including gameplay data; offered in some jurisdictions.
notes: NYT developer APIs cover news content only; there is no API for Games accounts or stats, and the Home Assistant integration uses the private app API (unofficial). The New York Times privacy policy says gameplay data (words played, scores, match statistics) is collected and that an electronic copy can be received for data portability through its request form. This is a one-off snapshot, not live puzzle stats.

name: Watch Duty
alternative: None official for the person's own data; official alert sources for the same area, e.g. National Weather Service alerts.
notes: Watch Duty's help centre says it has no public API and no data exports, its alerts arrive only as app push notifications (not email or SMS), and no Shortcuts, Siri or Apple Home support is documented. Its privacy policy offers access, correction or deletion by email to legal@watchduty.org or dpo@watchduty.org but does not say a copy or file of the data is provided.

name: Whisker
alternative: A privacy request through Whisker's Privacy Rights Portal (litter-robot.com/legal/privacy-request.html) or support@whisker.com for a copy of the person's personal information in a structured, machine-readable format; Whisker says it offers these choices to all users regardless of location.
notes: Litter-Robot maker with no public API or MCP; Home Assistant uses the community library github.com/natekspencer/pylitterbot against the private app API (unofficial). Whisker's privacy policy documents access and data-portability requests that deliver a copy in a machine-readable format, which gives a one-off snapshot rather than live robot activity.

name: 17TRACK
alternative: shipping notification emails in the person's mailbox
notes: The tracking API uses a self-serve key from a separate API account, but new accounts get only a one-time 200 tracking numbers, then paid plans; it does not expose the person's personal 17TRACK list.

name: Untappd
alternative: the person's check-in export (Untappd Insider)
notes: API v4 uses OAuth with a registered client ID and secret, 100 calls per hour; new app access is reported closed or approval-only, unconfirmed. Community MCPs github.com/darrenjrobinson/untappd-mcp-server and chrischall/untappd-mcp.

name: National Weather Service
alternative: none
notes: api.weather.gov is free open data with no key, only an identifying User-Agent; no account data. Community MCPs such as github.com/cyanheads/nws-weather-mcp-server.

name: RentCafe
alternative: rent payment receipts and notices in the person's mailbox
notes: Yardi's renter site and resident portal have no public API or MCP for residents.

name: Speedtest by Ookla
alternative: official Speedtest CLI on the Mac with JSON output
notes: No public web API for a person's results; Ookla's official CLI runs tests locally and outputs JSON, JSONL or CSV.

name: ReelShort
alternative: A privacy request emailed to reelshort.support@crazymaplestudio.com for the person's personal information in a structured, commonly used format (California residents under the CCPA; EEA, UK and Swiss users can request it ported "in a format that works for you"). App Store purchase receipts do not count.
notes: Short-drama streaming app from Crazy Maple Studio with no public API or MCP. Its privacy policy documents access and data-portability requests by email, which give a one-off snapshot of the personal information it holds rather than live access. Only some jurisdictions are covered.

name: State Bank of India
alternative: account statement download (PDF/Excel) from OnlineSBI
notes: No public consumer API or MCP; India's Account Aggregator network needs a regulated licence and routes data through a third party.

name: Asana
alternative: Asana REST API with a personal access token
notes: Asana documents the V2 server at mcp.asana.com/v2/mcp; its authorization server app.asana.com advertises no registration endpoint, client secret methods only, S256, so Kipster registers one Asana app. Discovery 2026-10-08: V2 DCR no, CIMD no, S256; the older mcp.asana.com root still advertises DCR but is not the documented server.

name: Trello
alternative: none
notes: Atlassian hosts the Trello MCP at mcp.trello.com/v1 with sign-in on auth.atlassian.com. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD yes, S256.

name: Loom
alternative: Loom video and transcript downloads from the person's library
notes: Loom tools (videos, transcripts, comments, action items) are served by the Atlassian Rovo MCP Server, but only for Loom workspaces linked to an Atlassian site; Loom has no standalone public REST API. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD yes, S256.

name: Guru
alternative: Guru MCP with a user API token from Admin > API Tokens
notes: Guru hosts an MCP server with OAuth or a user API token; its help pages call OAuth pre-approved for Claude, Cursor and ChatGPT, so DCR for other clients is unconfirmed. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD no, S256.

name: ClickUp
alternative: ClickUp REST API with the person's personal API token
notes: ClickUp's hosted MCP works on every plan including Free Forever and advertises DCR, but ClickUp keeps an allowlist of vetted MCP clients, so Kipster must be added to it. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes, CIMD no, S256.

name: Zoho Workplace
alternative: IMAP/SMTP and CalDAV for Zoho Mail and Calendar
notes: Zoho MCP is free: the person creates their own server in the Zoho MCP console, picks Mail, Cliq and other Workplace tools, and gets a per-server endpoint; official_mcp_url is the shape of Zoho's documented example (https://zylker-910551004.zohomcp.com/mcp/message?key=...), with the API key carried in the URL. Zoho authorizes the tools with OAuth 2.1 inside that server; no shared endpoint, so no discovery GET applies.

name: Mattermost
